tools.name: check_message
tools.description: Check a suspicious email, SMS, WhatsApp message, link or screenshot for scam signals. Controleer een verdachte mail, sms, WhatsApp-bericht, link of screenshot op signalen van oplichting. Documentation: https://scamchecker.nl/hoe-het-werkt

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_message · Public sink: check_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_message · Public sink: check_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
